sisi.depan: The far wall is dominated by a massive, cylindrical reactor housing glowing with a soft blue light, from which two enormous, polished bronze pipes extend horizontally.
sisi.kanan: On the right is a coolant control station featuring a bank of large, lotus-shaped valve wheels and a single, wide observation window looking into a chamber of swirling vapor.
sisi.belakang: A colossal, circular airlock door sealed with heavy, interlocking geometric latches is set into the rear wall, flanked by two vertical strips of amber status lights.
sisi.kiri: The left wall consists of a dense, vertical array of interwoven pipes in various metallic sheens and a maintenance lift with a cage of woven carbon fiber mesh.

tengah: A central, free-standing holographic control console faces the primary reactor, situated on a raised metal walkway whose floor grating has a stylized repeating geometric pattern.
atas: The high ceiling is a complex grid of smaller conduits and illuminated cable trays, with several large, inverted bell-shaped light fixtures suspended downwards.
